title: The Fodder Scam
dek: Government treasuries in undivided Bihar paid out for animal feed, medicine, and equipment that were never actually purchased — a scheme running for years before raids exposed it, and one that eventually sent the state's sitting Chief Minister to prison, across five separate cases.

heroStat.label: fraudulently withdrawn from Bihar's animal husbandry treasuries

promise.quote: Funds disbursed from state treasuries for the Animal Husbandry Department will be spent on genuine purchases of fodder, medicine, and livestock-related equipment.
promise.madeBy: Government of Bihar, Animal Husbandry Department
promise.role: State government department administering livestock-support spending
promise.context: Over roughly a decade, officials and contractors are alleged to have fraudulently withdrawn funds from district treasuries across undivided Bihar (including areas now in Jharkhand) using fake bills for supplies that were never delivered.

target.description: Treasury disbursements made only against genuine, verified purchases and deliveries, following standard state government financial controls.
target.standard: Standard treasury and financial-control rules governing state government departmental spending.

reality.description: Investigations found roughly ₹950 crore fraudulently withdrawn from treasuries in districts including Chaibasa, Deoghar, Dumka, and Doranda. Then-Chief Minister Lalu Prasad Yadav was named as an accused and has been convicted multiple times across different treasury cases, with combined sentences across four cases reported at 14 years, plus a further 5-year sentence and ₹60 lakh fine in a fifth case (the Doranda treasury case) in 2022. The Supreme Court has separately heard appeals concerning suspension of sentences in the case.

gap.metricLabel: Total alleged fraudulent withdrawal vs. amount specifically covered in Lalu Prasad Yadav's fifth (Doranda) conviction
gap.targetDisplay: ₹950 cr total alleged, across all treasury cases
gap.actualDisplay: ₹139 cr in the Doranda case specifically
gap.note: The scam spans multiple separate treasury cases prosecuted individually; the Doranda case is only one of several, so this is not a claim that only ₹139 crore in total was proven.

timeline.label: Raids expose the scam
timeline.detail: Raids on Animal Husbandry Department offices uncover the scale of fraudulent withdrawals.

timeline.label: First conviction
timeline.detail: Lalu Prasad Yadav is convicted in the Chaibasa treasury case, among the first of several.

timeline.label: Doranda case conviction
timeline.detail: A special CBI court sentences Yadav to five years and a ₹60 lakh fine in the fifth and largest treasury case.

timeline.label: Supreme Court hears sentence-suspension appeals
timeline.detail: The Court considers CBI appeals against a Jharkhand High Court order suspending sentences in the case.
